留空则收集全部变量: Leave empty to collect all variables
填写后每次迭代仅收集所选变量（须与变量名完全一致），减小结果体积。: When set, each iteration collects only the selected variables (must match variable names exactly) to reduce result size.
填写后每项结果仅收集所选变量（须与变量名完全一致），减小结果体积。: When set, each item result collects only the selected variables (must match variable names exactly) to reduce result size.
开启后，循环体内新建的变量会以原名写入全局状态（取最后一次迭代结束时的值）；对既: When enabled, variables newly created inside the loop body are written to global state under their own names (final iteration values); modifications to existing variables are not written back.
批处理并发迭代无全序，不支持将迭代内变量回写全局（persist_globals: Batch iterations run concurrently without a global order; writing iteration variables back to global state is unsupported (persist_globals is ignored). Use the loop controller to accumulate global state.
初始输入变量 JSON 格式错误！: Initial input variables JSON format error!

如果求值结果为 True，走 T 端口；反之走 F 端口。: If the result is True, goes to the T port; otherwise to the F port.

循环内部组件块: Internal component block of the loop
将运行产物沉淀为工作流长期记忆（跨实例共享，同 key 覆盖更新）: Persist run outputs as workflow long-term memory (shared across instances, upsert by key)
召回本工作流沉淀的长期记忆（语义检索 / 按业务身份精确取 / 时间线）: Recall workflow long-term memory (semantic search / exact key lookup / timeline)
请先选中要复制的节点: Select a node to duplicate first
来源运行实例（实例删除后仍保留编号溯源）: Source run instance (ID kept for tracing even after instance deletion)
选择记忆归属的工作流: Select the workflow this memory belongs to
沉淀给后续运行使用的事实/口径/决策，如：客户 X 报价口径 8 折: Facts / conventions / decisions to persist for future runs, e.g. Client X quotes at 20% off
回车添加，用于召回时粗滤: Press Enter to add; used as recall pre-filter
留空则不生成向量（走关键词召回）: Leave empty to skip embedding (keyword recall only)
填且生成成功 → 可语义召回；生成失败 → 仅关键词召回；留空 → 不生成向量。: Filled & success → semantic recall; failed → keyword recall only; empty → no embedding. Manual entries always go to production env, traced as admin-created
已保存，但内容疑似包含凭据模式，建议尽快处理：: Saved, but the content may contain credential patterns. Handle it soon:
确定删除该条记忆？删除后不再参与召回。如需修正内容，建议删旧后新增，或通过工作流: Delete this memory? It will no longer be recalled. To correct content, prefer delete-and-recreate, or upsert via a memory_store node with the same key template.
关闭后本工作流将不能写入新的长期记忆；已有记忆仍可被召回。确认关闭？: After turning this off, the workflow can no longer write new long-term memories; existing memories remain recallable. Turn off?
将基于 {version} 生成新草稿（线上版本不变），需在编辑器确认后发布。: A new draft will be created based on {version} (the live version stays unchanged) and must be confirmed in the editor before publishing.
至少配置一条赋值规则，点击添加: At least one assignment rule is required — click to add
点击左上角 + 按钮添加节点，开始构建工作流: Click the + button in the top-left corner to add nodes and start building
从节点面板拖拽或点击添加，拖拽连线构建工作流: Drag or click to add from the node palette, then connect nodes by dragging
将同时删除关联的循环体容器（容器内节点保留并移出到画布）。确认删除？: The associated loop-body container will also be deleted (nodes inside are kept and moved to the canvas). Delete?
内容过大，仅渲染前 2000 行；复制/全屏可获取完整内容: Content too large; only the first 2000 lines are rendered. Copy or view fullscreen for the full content
工作流最终输出落地成果（图片/文本/结构化数据）: Final output artifacts of the workflow (images / text / structured data)
已截断（复制全部可获取完整内容）: Truncated (copy all for the full content)
当工作流运行到成功终态并且 end 节点配置了输出字段时，产物将自动落库并在此展: When the workflow reaches a successful end state and the end node has output fields configured, artifacts will be stored automatically and shown here.
网络或服务异常导致产物列表未能获取，可点击重试。: The artifact list failed to load due to a network or service error. Click retry.
仅与写入时同模型同维度的记忆参与语义精排；向量不可用时自动走关键词匹配: Only memories with the same model and dimension as written participate in semantic re-ranking; falls back to keyword match when vectors are unavailable
仅语义检索适用；低于阈值的记忆不返回。0.35 为占位默认: Semantic search only; memories below the threshold are not returned. 0.35 is a placeholder default
从上游输出中选择待分类的文本来源变量；留空时依次使用全局 query / use: Pick the text source variable to classify from upstream outputs; when empty, falls back to the global query / user_query variables in order.
向量生成失败不阻断写入（该条记忆走关键词召回）；更换模型后旧记忆自动退出语义精排: Vectorization failure does not block writing (the memory falls back to keyword recall); after switching models, old memories automatically leave semantic re-ranking
回落 F 分支: Fall back to the F branch
失败中断：写入异常时节点报错；降级跳过：返回空 memory_id 继续执行: Fail and abort: the node errors on write failure; Downgrade and skip: returns an empty memory_id and continues
工作流存在多个\"开始节点\"，请在画布中保留唯一入口！: The workflow has multiple start nodes; keep a single entry in the canvas!
工作流缺失\"开始节点\"，请在画布中添加唯一入口！: The workflow is missing a start node; add a single entry in the canvas!
渲染后写入长期记忆；超长（>4000 字符）将直接失败不截断: Rendered then written to long-term memory; over-long content (>4000 chars) fails outright without truncation
演示占位工具，生产环境将执行失败: Demo placeholder tool; it fails in production
用于设定大模型角色、背景约束、输出格式等，支持使用变量插值。例如：你是一个经验丰: Set the LLM role, background constraints, output format, etc. Variable interpolation supported. E.g. You are an experienced front-end engineer...
用户当前输入的具体问题或任务，支持使用变量插值。例如：请帮我写一段关于 {inp: The user's current question or task. Variable interpolation supported. E.g. Please write a piece of code about {'{'}input_query{'}'}
留空走系统默认 embedding 模型: Empty for the system default embedding model
留空则依次回落 query / user_query: Empty to fall back to query / user_query in order
结束节点中存在未命名的输出字段！: The end node has unnamed output fields!

结束节点未配置输出结构模板！: The end node has no output structure template configured!
结构化列表 (list，含记忆 ID 可追踪): Structured list (list, traceable with memory IDs)
超预算时整条跳过（记忆不截半条）；首条命中即使超预算也会返回: Skip whole entries over budget (no partial memory); the first hit is returned even over budget
输出变量名重复，后执行节点会覆盖先前结果：: Duplicate output variable names; later nodes overwrite earlier results:
选择包含检索文本的上游变量: Pick the upstream variable containing the retrieval text
默认检索异常时返回空结果继续执行；失败中断则节点报错: By default an empty result is returned on retrieval errors and execution continues; with fail-and-abort the node errors out
偏好口径 (preference)——工作流级口径，非用户偏好: Preference — workflow-level convention, not a user preference
\"存在空白的 Case 匹配值！: " has a blank case match value!
该工作流此前执行失败，若失败点前存在待确认的人工审批断点，可从此处恢复继续执行：: This workflow failed earlier. If a pending human-approval breakpoint exists before the failure point, you can resume from it:

下载未能在后台完成，已尝试在新标签打开原图，可右键另存: Download could not complete in the background; the original image was opened in a new tab — right-click to save
图片获取失败，无法打包: Failed to fetch images; cannot pack
例如: data.user.name: E.g. data.user.name
例如: true 或 审批通过 的任何变量值: E.g. true or any variable value like approved
支持使用变量插值。例如：最终结果为 {LLM节点_output}: Variable interpolation supported. E.g. the final result is {'{'}LLM节点_output{'}'}
支持插值变量，例如：客户 {customerId} 的报价口径为 {quoteP: Variable interpolation supported. E.g. the quote policy for customer {'{'}customerId{'}'} is {'{'}quotePolicy{'}'}
支持插值变量，例如：画一张关于 {topic} 的图片: Variable interpolation supported. E.g. draw a picture about {'{'}topic{'}'}

选择或输入上游图片变量: Select or type an upstream image variable
